answer: Make attestation carry real risk: every identity locks a small bond in a shared pool, and peers who attest an answer stake part of their own bond on it. If the answer is later proven fake, the fake's bond is slashed and so is the bond of everyone who vouched for it, so attesters only vouch for identities they truly trust. A sybil farm can fake many identities, but each fake needs its own bond and vouches, and one exposed fake burns the whole cluster. Trust forms slowly under pressure like quartz, a reef grows only when builders contribute honestly, and jade is worthless if the stone is fake.
